steps.text: A document signed, received or prepared outside OptimCE is attached with the upload icon, on that document's row.
steps.title: Attach a file

steps.text: Drop the file in the dedicated area, or click to pick it from your computer.
steps.title: Choose the file

steps.text: Submit: the file becomes the document's current version. It is kept as it is, with its fingerprint, and will never be modified.
steps.title: Upload

steps.text: The document turns "Ready" and can be downloaded. A new file would add a version without erasing the previous one. Once every required document is ready, the procedure turns "Ready" by itself and offers to send it.
steps.title: The document is ready

title: Attach a file to a document
